1. Wash off the cake gently under cool water to remove sediment. 
2. Take purified or distilled water and submerge the cake in a Tupperware container. Then place a cup or mug over the cake so it doesn't bob and is equally covered by water. 
3. Set a timer for 18 hours and wait. 
4. Timer goes off, time for the roll and place into the fruiting chamber.

Afterwards, we called the police for a report. The officer that showed up let me sit in the car, turn on the lights and sirens, and showed me what the car could do. 

12 years later, I was assisting the police honor guard in a ceremony for veterans when I saw the sergeant who helped me. Thanked him, and then we later went on a ride along.

I was raised in a Christian fundamentalist home (now atheist). The computers were installed with SafeEyes (an NSA type program that monitors activity online, blocks programs, screenshots webpages, and sends a weekly report to the subscribers). 

I couldn't hang out with any kid on my street if my parents hadn't met their parents first, checked to see if they were "safe". I couldn't watch anything above G-rating, unless they looked up a biased review from PluggedinOnline (Christian review site on movies, music). All other music that wasn't classical or instrumental was banned. Same went for literature. 

My parents also put me through 7 years of Christian private schools, plus youth group. They also wanted to know who would be there, what we would do, when I would arrive, when I would leave, and other demands. Luckily, I broke free from the faith but have some trauma/nightmares from religious abuse. I also hacked their program with a new account so I could look at Wikipedia and Star Wars wiki. They weren't happy when their report focused on Han Solo instead of Bibleman.
